item.description: By Craig B. Barkacs MBA, JD, Power and InfluenceThis post is Part 1 of a series. item.title: Online Shopping Scam Reports – How To Spot Patterns In Frauds
item.description: Researchers at privacy company Incogni have conducted a study of online shopping scam reports reaching back nearly five years. Just after the holiday season, their study aimed to uncover patterns and trends in scams reportedly affecting consumers. By examining a large, up-to-date dataset, they were able to provide consumers with correlations and warning signs that could help keep them—and their wallets—protected during the seasonal retail rush. item.description: Search engine optimization has evolved far beyond keywords and backlinks. Two often underestimated but highly impactful elements are internal linking and image alt texts.
